name: google-calendar
description: Google Calendar via the official Calendar API v3: calendars, free/busy, free-slot search and events with Google Meet

nodes.title: List Google calendars
nodes.description: List the calendars on the account's calendar list with id, name, time zone and access role, and whether agent tools may use each one.

min_access_role.description: Only calendars with at least this role

show_hidden.description: Include calendars hidden from the list

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Query Google Calendar free/busy
nodes.description: Get busy intervals for up to 50 calendars in a time range. Per-calendar errors (e.g. notFound when not shared) are returned, not thrown.

calendar_ids.description: Calendars (or people's calendar emails) to check

time_min.description: Range start: RFC 3339 (2026-11-20T00:00:00+07:00) or a local date/date-time read in time_zone

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Find free Google Calendar slots
nodes.description: Find meeting slots of `duration_minutes` when every listed calendar is free, inside working hours (default Mon-Fri 09:00-17:00 in time_zone), with optional buffers around busy time. Range up to 62 days.

calendar_ids.description: Calendars (or people's calendar emails) to check

time_min.description: Range start: RFC 3339 (2026-11-20T00:00:00+07:00) or a local date/date-time read in time_zone

time_zone.description: IANA zone for working hours and results; default the account's Calendar setting

working_hours.description: Windows per weekday, e.g. {"mon": ["09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00"], "sat": ["10:00-14:00"]}; days left out have no slots

buffer_minutes.description: Free time to keep before and after busy time

slot_step_minutes.description: Spacing of candidate start times from each window's start

extra_busy.description: More busy time [{"start", "end"}] as date-times, or dates for whole days

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List Google Calendar events
nodes.description: List events in a time range, optionally matching text `q`. Recurring events are expanded and sorted by start by default.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id: "primary" (the account's main calendar) or an id from list_calendars

time_min.description: Only events ending after this (RFC 3339, or a local date/date-time with time_zone)

q.description: Free-text search in title, description, location, attendees

single_events.description: Expand recurring events into single occurrences

order_by.description: Default startTime when single_events is true

private_properties.description: Only events whose private properties have these values {name: value}

created_by_plugin.description: Only events created by this plugin

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get Google Calendar event
nodes.description: Get one event with its times, attendees and their responses, Meet link and private properties.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id: "primary" (the account's main calendar) or an id from list_calendars

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create Google Calendar event
nodes.description: Create an event (timed or all-day) with optional guests, reminders and a Google Meet link. Pass idempotency_key to make retries safe; book_slot re-checks free/busy first and fails `conflict` if the time was taken or the key already booked another time.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id: "primary" (the account's main calendar) or an id from list_calendars

start.description: Start: date-time "2026-11-20T09:00:00+07:00" (or without offset plus `time_zone`), or a date "2026-11-20" for an all-day event

end.description: End, same form as start (exclusive); for all-day events defaults to the next day

attendees.description: Guests: emails or {"email", "optional", "display_name"} objects. On update this replaces the whole list

reminders.description: Up to 5 reminders like {"method": "popup" | "email", "minutes": 30} (minutes before start, max 40320)

recurrence.description: RFC 5545 lines, e.g. ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=4"]; needs time_zone for timed events

private_properties.description: Private extended properties {name: value} stored on this calendar's copy, e.g. a booking id

add_google_meet.description: Create a Google Meet link for the event

send_updates.description: Who gets an email about the change. Agent tools always use none unless GOOGLE_CALENDAR_TOOL_SEND_UPDATES=1

idempotency_key.description: Same key = same event: a repeat returns the existing event instead of a duplicate

event_id.description: Explicit new event id: 5-1024 characters of a-v and 0-9

book_slot.description: Re-check that the calendar is free for start-end right before creating

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Update Google Calendar event
nodes.description: Change some fields of an event (PATCH): only the given fields change; `attendees` replaces the whole guest list. Agent tools may only update events this plugin created.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id: "primary" (the account's main calendar) or an id from list_calendars

start.description: Start: date-time "2026-11-20T09:00:00+07:00" (or without offset plus `time_zone`), or a date "2026-11-20" for an all-day event

end.description: End, same form as start (exclusive); for all-day events defaults to the next day

attendees.description: Guests: emails or {"email", "optional", "display_name"} objects. On update this replaces the whole list

reminders.description: Up to 5 reminders like {"method": "popup" | "email", "minutes": 30} (minutes before start, max 40320)

recurrence.description: RFC 5545 lines, e.g. ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=4"]; needs time_zone for timed events

private_properties.description: Private extended properties {name: value} stored on this calendar's copy, e.g. a booking id

add_google_meet.description: Create a Google Meet link for the event

send_updates.description: Who gets an email about the change. Agent tools always use none unless GOOGLE_CALENDAR_TOOL_SEND_UPDATES=1

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Delete Google Calendar event
nodes.description: Delete an event. Deleting one that is already deleted succeeds. Agent tools may only delete events this plugin created.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id: "primary" (the account's main calendar) or an id from list_calendars

send_updates.description: Who gets an email about the change. Agent tools always use none unless GOOGLE_CALENDAR_TOOL_SEND_UPDATES=1

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Quick add Google Calendar event
nodes.description: Create an event from text, e.g. "Lunch with Sari tomorrow 12:30-13:30 at Kopi Kenangan". Not retried after an unknown outcome.

calendar_id.description: Calendar id: "primary" (the account's main calendar) or an id from list_calendars

text.description: Event description in natural language (English works best)

send_updates.description: Who gets an email about the change. Agent tools always use none unless GOOGLE_CALENDAR_TOOL_SEND_UPDATES=1

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Google Calendar API request
nodes.description: Call any Google Calendar API endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/colors". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/colors"

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
